turn.message: Baseline confirmed in production rollout #46033856775: PT Cavitacao 6.369 s, PT Aqua 4.597 s, PT Pressoterapia 3.848 s, PT HIFU 3.415 s, PT Laser 2.541 s, PT home 2.444 s. PR 293 preserves existing fact-selection predicates and replaces observation-driven correlated scans with one bounded query per visible offer set plus one distinct-row fetch. Review 845 tests (reference parity in both price modes, ties, stale/future/ES/USD/null data, duplicate offers), browser QA and no migration drift. Only 3 source/test files. Guarded rollout requires all 23 URLs, canonical/hreflang, exact public headings, images, ordered offer cards/prices/currencies, affiliate destinations and sitemaps unchanged; require measured Cavitacao improvement, no material homepage regression, unchanged service/timers and pinned Git revision; rollback on failure. After rollout capture public REA timings and independently repeat Core-sites. Search Console remains unverified.
